interface.title: GeneQuantify: Expression & CNV Analysis
interface.field: Molecular biology: relative gene-expression analysis of real-time qPCR data
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis and reporting, after the qPCR run once Cq values are in hand
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn replicate Cq values for control and patient/treatment groups into ΔΔCq (Livak) and Pfaffl fold changes, with outlier screening, reference-gene stability checks, automatic choice of statistical test, multiple-testing correction, plots and CSV/PDF export. Despite 'CNV' in the title, no separate copy-number mode was seen; relative CNV would go through the same ΔΔCq path.

data.note: Most work used the sidebar 'Load Validation Scenario' sets: S2 (3 genes, 2 groups, 2 reference genes), S1D (Mann-Whitney), S4 (ANOVA with 3 groups) and S3 (Grubbs outlier). I also typed my own Cq values by hand (6 replicates per group, with one control replicate at 27.90 placed as an outlier). The test file example_qpcr.rdes.txt uploaded and was read (24 reactions found), but pressing 'Apply RDES import to Data Entry' crashed the app with NameError: apply_import_to_session is not defined (screens/044.webp), so no analysis ran on the uploaded file.

tree.general: Find out how much a gene's expression changes between control and treated/patient samples, and whether the change is statistically significant
tree.specific: Compute 2^-ΔΔCq and Pfaffl fold changes from qPCR Cq replicates, check them, test them and export a report

features.name: Replicate outlier screen with per-sample exclusion
features.general: Run an outlier test on each group's replicate measurements, list the flagged samples, let the user tick which to exclude, and pass the exclusions on to all later calculations and exports
features.specific: Choose Grubbs (α) or IQR (k) and the stage (Raw Cq or ΔCq); a warning lists the flagged sample and its Ct; tick 'Exclude Sample N'; the info box shows remaining n; the Results table marks the row EXCLUDED / 'Yes (IQR)'
steps: Enable outlier detection and pick Grubbs or IQR
Set α or the IQR multiplier k, and the detection stage
Enter or paste replicates; read the flagged-sample warning
Tick 'Exclude Sample N' and watch the fold change update
Check the excluded row in the Input Data Table and exports
serves_tasks: Find and drop aberrant replicate measurements

features.name: Standard-curve efficiency calculator

features.specific: 📐 Standard Curve Calculator: set gene label, number of dilution points, dilution factor and starting concentration; enter the mean Cq per dilution; press Calculate Efficiency to get slope, E, Efficiency % and R², with a hint to copy E into the efficiency inputs
steps: Expand the calculator
Set number of points, dilution factor and starting concentration
Enter the mean Cq for each dilution
Press Calculate Efficiency
Read slope / E / % / R² and copy E into the gene efficiency fields
serves_tasks: Estimate amplification efficiency from a dilution series
Check that the assays amplify with comparable efficiency

features.name: Efficiency-mismatch check per target/reference pair
features.general: Enter efficiency directly or derive it from a slope for each pair of assays, and warn when the two differ by more than a set threshold
features.specific: The Efficiency Input Method radio (Enter E manually / Calculate from slope) and the threshold %; each 'Target Gene N — Efficiency' expander shows E, % and a green or yellow verdict; E values feed the Pfaffl ratio
steps: Choose the input method: E or slope
Set the acceptable difference threshold
Enter target and reference values per gene
Read the acceptable / exceeds-threshold verdict
serves_tasks: Check that the assays amplify with comparable efficiency
Compare two ways of calculating the fold change

features.name: Reference-gene stability panel (geNorm M / CV)
features.general: When several normalising controls are used, compute a stability score and a variability score for each, chart them against acceptance lines, and give a verdict per group
features.specific: Set 'Number of reference genes per target gene' to 2 or more; each group gets M-value and CV% cards, a geNorm M-value bar chart with M=0.5 and M=1.0 lines, and an 'All stable' status
steps: Set the number of reference genes to 2 or more
Paste Cq for each reference gene per group
Read the M and CV cards and the chart against the 0.5 / 1.0 thresholds
Act on the stable / unstable verdict
serves_tasks: Check that the normalising control genes are stable

features.name: Explained automatic test selection

steps: Enter the groups' data

Read the normality and variance results
Read the selected test, the reason and the p-value
